title: 'settles this hold's grief: rests it' vs '...: a bargain' labels are accurate and trustworthy wherever they appear, but the specific action set offered at a grief-scene often depends on items/knowledge gathered in an entirely different room with no hint left behind — e.g. the Reeve's Pride wreck shows only the 'pay 6 gold' bargain option until you've separately gotten the sailors' verse from Widow Kestrel AND lit the Farlight lighthouse, and nothing at the wreck itself says a fuller path exists elsewhere on the map.
